findings.rationale: The new adjective-sense target collocation:principal-dancer/example:principal-dancer is linked through C-001 only to F-001, F-013, and F-016 at Merriam-Webster, Cambridge, and Collins. Those recorded facts support the general adjective meaning and cite ingredient/city or aim/reason examples, but none directly attests the performing-arts collocation a principal dancer or its sense-specific application. F-018 does record principal dancer in its source detail, but it is linked only through C-003 to the separate noun-performing-arts and orchestral targets. The fixed evidence therefore contains the needed fact but does not link it to this adjective target.
findings.suggested_direction: Bind F-018 directly to the adjective principal-dancer target (with its part-of-speech scope made explicit), or remove/hold this collocation and example from sense 1.
